newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT - New Zealand ski report for June 17.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT - New Zealand ski report for June 17.

text.p: Note to subscribers - At present this report is compiled from individual field reports. We will resume a more comprehensive service as soon as the New Zealand Ski Council introduces it for the current season. It is expected next week.
BASE: 30-50 cm upper M1 base, 10-20 cm lower
WEATHER: Overcast, limited visibility on upper part of mountain.
ROAD CONDITIONS: Clear, chains to be carried

FACILITIES: Coronet Express open, Meadows Chair (foot access to lower M1 only), Learner Lifts (upper handle tow only). All base lodge facilities available. Closed - Greengates chair, Rocky Gully T-Bar, Big Easy Platter.
WEATHER: Calm, high cloud above basin. Good visibility.
ROAD CONDITIONS: Chains to be carried
